annotation.title_clean: Communication from the Commission to the European Parliament pursuant to Article 294(6) TFEU concerning the position of the Council on the adoption of a Regulation establishing the Digital Europe programme for 2021-2027
annotation.title_en: Communication from the Commission to the European Parliament pursuant to Article 294(6) TFEU concerning the position of the Council on the adoption of a Regulation establishing the Digital Europe programme for 2021-2027
annotation.summary_en: Commission communication to the European Parliament on the Council's first-reading position adopting the Digital Europe programme 2021-2027 (EUR 7.59 billion), covering AI, high-performance computing, cybersecurity, digital skills and interoperability. It outlines the legislative timeline and changes agreed in trilogues, and accepts the Council's position.
key_provisions_or_claims: Digital Europe programme has a EUR 7.59 billion envelope for 2021-2027
Five specific objectives: HPC, AI, cybersecurity and trust, advanced digital skills, deployment and interoperability
Climate spending target raised to 30% and biodiversity target added
Work programmes adopted via implementing acts; partial association of third countries allowed
Commission accepts the Council's first-reading position
